description.value: Oak Bay Bikes is a long-established full-service bicycle retailer in Victoria's Oak Bay neighbourhood, carrying major brands including Trek, Norco, Santa Cruz, Surly, Orbea, and Gazelle alongside an extensive parts and accessories inventory. The shop runs a dedicated suspension centre and separate e-bike service stream, making it one of the more comprehensively equipped shops on Vancouver Island for cyclists needing technical work. An active community program — including a weekly Wednesday night ride and a rides-and-events calendar — gives touring cyclists a ready entry point into local riding knowledge.
